title: Time travellers: centuries and decades
summary: Learn to measure historical time using decades and centuries.
keyIdeas: A decade is a period of 10 consecutive years.
A century is a period of 100 consecutive years, or 10 decades.
In Spanish history lessons, centuries are often written with Roman numerals, such as century XXI, the twenty-first century.

basicKnowledge: C. Sociedades y territorios › Sociedades en el tiempo

activities.prompt: A decade is a period of 10 years.
activities.explanation: A decade lasts exactly 10 years. Ten decades, or 10 × 10 years, make a century.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct number.
activities.explanation: A century contains 100 years. Ten years make a decade.
activities.sentence: A century is a period lasting ___ years.

activities.prompt: Match each unit of time to its length.
activities.explanation: A lustrum is 5 years, a decade is 10, a century is 100 and a millennium is 1000 years.

activities.prompt: Omar's grandfather was born exactly 70 years ago. How many decades has he lived?
activities.explanation: Each decade has 10 years, so 70 ÷ 10 = 7 decades.
activities.hint: Remember that each group of 10 years is a decade.

activities.prompt: Sort these lengths of time by whether they are shown as groups of decades or centuries.
activities.explanation: A decade is 10 years and a century is 100 years. Both units can describe lengths of time.

items.text: 300 years: three groups of a hundred
500 years: five groups of a hundred

activities.prompt: Put these units of time in order from shortest to longest.
activities.explanation: A year is shorter than a decade (10 years), which is shorter than half a century (50 years). A full century is 100 years.

activities.prompt: Complete the calculation about Martina's school.
activities.explanation: A centenary marks 100 years. Each decade is 10 years, so 100 years equal 10 decades.
activities.sentence: Martina's school celebrated its centenary. It had completed ___ decades of history.

activities.prompt: Imagine it is the year 2000. A castle was built in 1200. How many centuries have passed?
activities.explanation: From 1200 to 2000 is 800 years. Each century has 100 years, so 800 years equal 8 centuries.
activities.hint: Subtract the years and count the groups of 100.

activities.prompt: Read the story of the tower clock in Lucía's village.
activities.explanation: Two centuries equal 200 years, and four decades equal 40 years.
activities.title: The great clock in the square
activities.text: Lucía's village has a tower with a large clock and a bell. Residents say that the clock began working two full centuries ago. Clockmakers have cared for its machinery throughout that time. Four decades ago, the old iron hands were replaced with shiny bronze ones. Today, children and adults still hear its chimes every hour. It is the village's best-loved monument.

questions.prompt: How many years has the tower clock been working?
questions.explanation: The text says two full centuries, which equal 200 years.

questions.prompt: How many years ago were the hands replaced with bronze ones?
questions.explanation: Four decades are 4 groups of 10 years: 40 years.

activities.prompt: A municipal library is 6 decades and 5 years old. How many more years until it is a century old?
activities.explanation: 6 decades and 5 years equal 65 years. To reach a century: 100 - 65 = 35 years.
activities.hint: First, calculate the library's total age in years.
